title: Sumo wrestler Ansei Nishiki wins Nagoya tournament for third time and regains ōzeki rank
summary: Ansei Nishiki prevailed in a triple playoff to claim the Emperor's Cup, marking the first time a wrestler has been promoted to ōzeki via the special route in the same tournament.

title: Tenth anniversary of the Yamayuri residence attack: floral offerings and calls for inclusion
summary: Family members, residents, and citizens remembered the victims of the tragic 2016 incident, calling for a society without discrimination against people with disabilities.

title: Car plows into crowd at Berlin Pride parade: one dead and 29 injured
summary: The German government describes the attack as terrorist and investigates possible involvement of Islamic State sympathizers.

title: United States suspends airstrikes on Iran and Trump considers not launching a major offensive
summary: The decision is due to concerns over the depletion of defensive missiles, while Iran claims to have secret missile bases ready to respond.

title: Forest fires in France and Spain force evacuation of over 300,000 people
summary: High temperatures and drought cause large fires in southwestern Europe, causing at least one fatality.

title: UNESCO declares Asuka and Fujiwara palace sites in Japan as World Heritage
summary: The international recognition covers ancient tombs and archaeological remains, sparking celebrations in local communities and plans to boost tourism.

title: Takadai Koryu High School returns to Kōshien after 24-year absence
summary: With a three-run home run in the ninth inning, the team achieved a dramatic victory to secure its ticket to the national high school baseball tournament.

title: Zelenskyy claims Russia has requested 30,000 North Korean soldiers for the war
summary: The Ukrainian president asserts that Russia is in talks with North Korea to receive additional troops and is instructing them in military tactics.

title: Flash floods in Niigata and Toyama after record rainfall
summary: Authorities issue level 4 alerts for risk of landslides and overflows, while rescue teams assess the damage.

title: Ishin party in Hyogo expels a member for renting campaign vehicles without permission
summary: The disciplinary measure was taken after it was discovered that the legislator was operating a rental business for campaign cars without the required authorization.

title: Hanshin Tigers defeat Yomiuri Giants and tie for the lead
summary: Pitcher Murakami throws a complete game shutout to lead his team to victory at the close of the first half of the season.

title: Japanese fencer Yamada Yu wins bronze at World Championships for second consecutive time
summary: In the épée event, Yamada Yu steps onto the podium, while Japanese fencer Emura Miesaki does not advance past the third round.

title: Yokohama High School secures its place in Kōshien by defeating Tōgaku School
summary: The Yokohama team wins the prefectural final and advances to the national high school baseball tournament for the second consecutive year.

title: Hana Sakura Tokuharu High School earns the right to participate in Kōshien
summary: With a late offensive, the Saitama team defeats Urawa Gakuin and secures its presence in the summer championship for the ninth time.

title: Nitta School earns ticket to Kōshien for second time in five years
summary: Nitta defeats Matsuyama Gakuin with a score of 12-3 and seals its qualification for the national high school baseball tournament.

title: Polls show drop in approval for Prime Minister Takaichi's cabinet
summary: Approval falls to 57% according to a Yomiuri poll, while Kyodo puts it at 53%, and a majority considers the prime minister's explanations insufficient.

title: 84% of Japanese support the idea of a reigning empress, according to polls
summary: Public opinion is divided on whether succession through adopted children from the former imperial family should be allowed, showing the complexity of the debate.
